title: Motion Video Timeline
description: Single source of truth for a code-generated video: visuals, audio and captions all read cue times from here. Validate before rendering; any manual time in scene code is a bug.

fps.description: Frames per second. All durations derive from this — never animate in milliseconds.

duration.description: Total duration in seconds. durationInFrames = round(duration × fps).

bpm.description: Declared tempo grid. beat = 60/bpm seconds; bar = 4 beats. Land visual events on this grid instead of detecting tempo.

palette.description: Master palette (hex). index 0 = background convention; last = accent convention.

fonts.description: Role → typeface map, e.g. { display: 'Archivo Black', body: 'Inter' }. Preload before frame 0.

music.description: 'synth' (generate on the bpm grid) | path to a track (analyze with beat_grid.py) | null

vo.description: Path to voiceover, or null. Generate before animating: narration paces everything.

id.description: Matches the scene renderer key in the engine code.

duration.description: 3–6s typical; land boundaries on the beat grid.

text.description: Exact on-screen words (≤ 5 words). Hold ≥ 0.3s/word + 0.5s, min 1.4s.

device.description: The one visual device this scene executes (e.g. 'word-per-beat pops').

palette.description: Optional per-scene emphasis (color script) — must be a subset/reorder of the master palette.

cueTimes.description: Absolute times of in-scene events; visuals and audio read the same values.

captions.description: Word-level caption pages (from TTS timestamps or whisper forced alignment).

style.description: Named style preset from motion-craft.md §7 or a measured custom style.
